concerts.title: Paddington the Musical

credits: Music and lyrics by Tom Fletcher
concerts.desc: Royal Variety Performance, Royal Albert Hall (2025). Music and lyrics by Tom Fletcher. Orchestrations by Simon Nathan.

concerts.title: John Wilson Orchestra/Sinfonia of London
concerts.desc: Simon has worked on many projects with both the John Wilson Orchestra and Sinfonia of London, such as arrangements for tours and proms, as well as reconstructions by ear of film scores, including music lost in 1965 MGM vault fire.

concerts.title: Lucerne Festival Orchestra
concerts.desc: In celebration of their outgoing Festival Director, Michael Haefliger, after 26 years with the Orchestra, Simon created an arrangement that included huge variety of music from Boulez to Mozart to swiss folk song to football chants!

concerts.title: Deutsches Symphonie-Orchester Berlin
concerts.desc: Since 2022, Simon has arranged several new pieces every year for their fantastic circus tent concert! Each piece features and highlights different orchestral instruments to accompany the circus performers.

concerts.title: BBC Symphony Orchestra
concerts.desc: Simon has worked on 3 concerts, including 4 or 5 arrangements where the orchestra collaborates with great writers to perform pieces inspired by stories.

concerts.title: BBC Concert Orchestra
concerts.desc: An Alan Menken concert in conjunction with the BBC Singers. Simon worked on scaling up orchestrations, including songs from the Hunchback of Notre Dame and a song written by Menken called Star Spangled Man for Captain America.

concerts.title: BBC National Orchestra of Wales
concerts.desc: Friday Night is Music Night - arrangement of Waving Through a Window.

concerts.title: Hallé Orchestra
concerts.desc: Friday Night is Music Night - arrangement of Waving Through a Window.

concerts.title: Mulhouse Symphony Orchestra
concerts.desc: Live to Picture performance of Laurel and Hardy. This was an hour-long composition by Fabien Cali and arranged by Simon to accompany the film.

concerts.title: Aalborg Symphony Orchestra
concerts.desc: Edition of a previously unperformed piece of music by Pavel Haas - a Jewish composer who was tragically taken to a concentration camp before being able to complete his symphony. Simon was an editor of the piece and his version was published by Boosey and Hawkes.

concerts.title: London Musical Theatre Orchestra
concerts.desc: Simon has worked on many LMTO concerts from A Christmas Carol and Honeymoon in Vegas, to Magic at the Musicals at The Royal Albert Hall.

concerts.title: London Gay Men's Chorus
concerts.desc: Simon has created around 200 arrangements for the Gay Men’s Chorus from 2015-2022.

concerts.title: Beanlandia - Rowan Atkinson Suite
concerts.desc: A medley of music written by Howard Goodall for Rowan Atkinson’s 60th birthday, which was arranged and orchestrated by Simon. It is published by Faber.
